name: Sapphirus Honeysuckle
original_name: サピルス・ハニーサックル
source:
Police Corps Captain that serves the [url=/c156156]Crown Prince[/url].
I hear he's a cold-hearted machine with unwavering loyalty to his duties and the Imperial Family!
The Prince's orders are absolute! That's the kind of guy he is. Apparently, he can go a little overboard trying to get things done. Seriously, the military is scary!

[From Digital Artwork book]
